data.change_summary: Removed the redundant light-intensity multiplication from habitat periphyton growth so habitat registry light exposure is not squared, updated `algae_growth` documentation/comments to reflect the now-shipped habitat split and habitat-aware grazing, and changed `CleanFilter` so decomposer setback is concentrated on `FilterMedia` with smaller or zero effects on other habitats while DOC/DON routing is based on biomass actually removed. Added/updated regressions for filter-cleaning habitat specificity and budget accounting, and confirmed `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs` is already tracked in git.
outstanding_risks: Validation covered the affected `tank_core` regression suites, not the full workspace test suite.
The new filter-cleaning habitat setback coefficients are still hardcoded heuristics and may need scenario-level retuning as more maintenance/habitat interactions land.

steps.description: Inspected the pending amendment sites in `algae_growth.rs`, `engine.rs`, and the affected tests, and verified the git tracking state for `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs`.

Patched per-habitat periphyton light handling and stale habitat-split comments, then reworked `CleanFilter` decomposer setback to be habitat-specific with actual removed biomass routed into dissolved organics.
Extended habitat/budget regressions for the filter-cleaning behavior and reran targeted validation on habitat pools, budget tracking, and cycling filter-cleaning coverage.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_biomass_pools` passed (14 tests), including the new filter-cleaning habitat regression.
`git ls-files --error-unmatch crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs` confirmed the regression file is tracked.
